Input contains ASCII characters. Ignore everything except ASCII letters and digits, compare case-insensitively, and return whether the remaining sequence is a palindrome. An empty sequence is a palindrome.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "Never odd, or even!"
  ],
  "expected": true
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "robot"
  ],
  "expected": false
}
Hint

Normalize first, then compare both directions.

Complexity: O(n) time and space
